headline: WNBA Finals Game 3: Valkyries at Dream, series tied 1-1
whyCareReason: Atlanta tied the series with a 79-65 win. Game 3 is Wednesday at State Farm Arena. No score is posted.
teaser: Wednesday 21 October, 8:00 p.m. ET, USA, Peacock and CNBC. ESPN lists Atlanta -3.5.
story: Game 3 of the WNBA Finals is Wednesday, 21 October, at State Farm Arena in Atlanta. ESPN, CBS and the league schedule list tip at 8:00 p.m. ET on USA Network, Peacock and CNBC. The Golden State Valkyries visit the Atlanta Dream. The series is tied 1-1 after Atlanta's 79-65 win in Game 2. Game 1 was Valkyries 68, Dream 64. No Game 3 score is posted. ESPN lists Atlanta as a 3.5-point favorite.
stakes: The winner of Wednesday leads the Finals 2-1. Both clubs are still chasing a first title.
rivalryAngle: The series moves to Atlanta level after the Dream's first Finals win.
funFacts: Game 2 final: Dream 79, Valkyries 65. Reese 30 points and 16 rebounds.
Game 3: Wednesday 21 October, 8:00 p.m. ET, State Farm Arena. Status upcoming.
